WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.R.KRISHNA KUMAR  ORAL ORDER (PER: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE S.R.KRISHNA KUMAR)

In this petition, the petitioner seeks the following reliefs:
"A writ in the nature of mandamus directing the respondents to initiate acquisition proceedings as per the provisions of act no.30/2013 in respect of land baring Sy.no.171/Aa, measuring 4 acre 07 guntas Sy.no.171/A, measuring 03 acre 25 guntas Sy.no.171/aa measuring 01 acre 23 guntas, Sy.no.171/Ee measuring 4 acre 00 guntas in respect of petitioner to the extent of the used portion for laying ring road and pipeline, all situated at Yadagi B. Village near railway station, tq.
And dist
. Yadgir,
within a time bound period, the interest of justice and equity."

A perusal of the material on record will indicate that it is a specific contention of the petitioner that, the subject lands owned and possessed by the petitioner in Survey No.171/Aa, 171/A, 171/Aa,
Mallikarjun S/O Narasappa Chintanalli ... vs The State Of Karnataka And Ors on 7 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/197173696/
3 171/Ee, situated at Yadgir B village, have been forcibly utilized by the respondents for the purpose of ring road, without initiating acquisition proceedings, nor paying compensation and without following due process of law and since the request of the petitioner to the respondent No.2 - Deputy Commissioner who in turn directed respondent Nos.3 to 5 to take action, have not been complied with even till today, the petitioner is before this Court by way of the present writ petition.
3. Per contra, learned Additional Government Advocate as well as learned counsel for the respondents submits that, if a reasonable time is granted the respondents would address the grievance of the petitioner and proceed further in accordance with law.
4.

In view of the aforesaid facts and circumstances, I deem it just and appropriate to dispose of this petition, directing the jurisdictional ADLR to conduct a joint NC: 2024:KHC-K:8180 survey/inspection of the subject lands in the presence of the petitioner and respondents and secure a report and proceed further to address the grievance of the petitioner in accordance with law,
within a period of three months from the date of receipt of the copy of this order.

5. It is needless to state that, in the event if the joint survey/Inspection Report discloses that the subject lands of the petitioner or any portion thereof has been utilized for the purpose of ring road without acquisition proceedings, the concerned respondents shall initiate acquisition proceedings and pay the compensation to the petitioner as expeditiously as possible.
6. Subject to the aforesaid directions, the writ petition stands disposed of.

Sd/-
(S.R.KRISHNA KUMAR) JUDGE SVH Mallikarjun S/O Narasappa Chintanalli ... vs The State Of Karnataka And Ors on 7 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/197173696/
